name: Spear of Bloodlust
body:
Aura moderate evocation and transmutation; CL 10th; Slot none; Price 32,302 gp; Weight 6 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This +1 spear is infused with Ares’ power, urging its wielder to unleash devastating attacks. It has the keen and wounding weapon special abilities.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells bleed, keen edge; Cost 16,151 gp
